construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch within the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: schema_version, synthetic=true, customer, ledger, loan_application (object or null), products, query
shared_schema.customer: id, kyc_status (verified/pending/rejected), aml_flags[], preferences[], risk_tolerance (0..5), account_iban (explicit SYNTH- identifier)
shared_schema.ledger: format (json/csv/iso20022), data; normalized transactions: id, date YYYY-MM-DD, finite signed amount, currency, category, masked_card
shared_schema.csv: Exact headers: id,date,amount,currency,category,card_number; empty card_number is permitted
shared_schema.iso20022_style: CstmrCdtTrfInitn.PmtInf[] containing EndToEndId, ReqdExctnDt, InstdAmt {value,Ccy}, CtgyPurp, optional CardNumber; intentionally simplified JSON, not full ISO XML
shared_schema.product: id, name, category, tags[], risk (0..5), kind (account/card/loan/investment), currency, max_amount
shared_schema.scores: product_id, score, explanation[] of reason and points; every score equals its component sum
shared_schema.validation: validate_state runs at normalized ingress and before/after every stage; unknown fields, duplicates, nonfinite numbers, invalid dates, unmasked cards, ineligible results and inconsistent score propagation are rejected
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status=error, exit 2; generic messages avoid echoing sensitive invalid inputs

cross_stage_handoffs: normalize_input converts all ledger formats to the shared validated state and masks cards
recommend consumes validated state and emits screened, eligibility-filtered scored candidates
search consumes validated recommend output only; never introduces products outside those candidates; discovery score retained as the first explained component

behavior.discovery: Deterministic baseline 10, 20 per distinct preference token match, 5 per distinct historical category token match, 25 for an eligible loan application match; sort descending score then product id
behavior.search: Case folding, punctuation tokenization, synonym normalization, deterministic typo matching cutoff 0.8 for tokens of length >=4; all meaningful query terms must match; exact/alias match adds 40, typo adds 25; blank/stopword-only query preserves discovery ranking
behavior.financial_constraints: Pending/rejected KYC or any AML flag suppresses all recommendations and search results. Product risk must not exceed customer tolerance. Loans require nondeclined application, matching currency and amount within product maximum.
behavior.masking: Only last four card digits survive in normalized state. Demonstrative PCI DSS-inspired masking, not PCI certification. No raw ledger is carried forward.
behavior.fixtures: Explicit synthetic marker, fabricated customer, fake SYNTH account/IBAN identifier, all-zero fake card prefix; test fixture uses seed 45 randomized transaction histories
behavior.mutability: Stages deep-copy their inputs and never modify caller data
